purpose: Track whether canonical knowledge records are reachable from governed Room/House reader surfaces without requiring every record to be individually featured.

intentionally_excluded.reason: Retired predecessor corpus. Current character/institution ownership lives under knowledge/cia/ and legacy public FBI routes are compatibility-only.

Private-library artwork acquisition queue only. Original image bytes have not been imported into public GitHub gallery; exclude until published and properly linked, without marking artworks as publicly available.

editorial_rule: Reachability is not prominence. A record can be reachable through a deep drawer without being promoted to a featured object. Promotion remains an editorial decision based on explanatory value, provenance, maturity and reader need.
boundary: Coverage measures navigable integration, not truth, freshness or reader quality. The intentionally excluded set includes 41 retired FBI records and one unpublished private-gallery import queue; excluded does not always mean retired.
